observation.command: cd /workspace/dist && echo "===basic resources img==="; ls basic/resources/img | head; echo "===mastercode version dir contents==="; ls mastercode/3_26_1_410dc25_git_last_commit_at_2026-09-23__10-05-39/; echo "===count locale json==="; find mastercode/*/locales -name '*.json' | wc -l; echo "===draw svgs count==="; ls mastercode/*/img/tools/draw/*.svg | wc -l; echo "===bundle size==="; du -h mastercode/*/js/masterportal.js mastercode/*/css/masterportal.css; echo "===index portal variants==="; for d in basic master auto; do grep -l "mastercode" $d/index.html >/dev/null && echo "$d/index.html references mastercode OK"; done
